answer: Because the zenith collateral is checked against the voyage claim at intake, the plume audit records the ratio and an under-collateralised submission is refused. Posted collateral must equal 6 times the reward claimed, so ambition is priced rather than free. A farm claiming large rewards across many aliases hence has to lock proportionally more capital on each, which removes the advantage of spreading claims thin. That is 31 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
